verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker so failed events can be replayed instead of lost, addressing the 'pipeline breaks' half of the story, but there is no evidence of replaying archived/warehouse-stored events into a newly added destination for backfill purposes. Missing for 10: documented ability to re-stream historical/archived events to a new destination, retention/lookback window for such replays, and any tooling (CLI/UI) specifically for backfill jobs.
